name: Dear Diary
source:
Dear Diary is a visual novel exclusively for adults! This story is about a guy who liked to pick mushrooms in the forest. On one of the most ordinary days, he met a girl. This girl changed his life once and for all!

In this wonderful game you have to plunge into the story of a guy who kept his personal diary and wrote down everything that happens to him. He wrote down the story there, how he met a girl in the forest and began to spy on her. The girl bathed in the lake naked. He really enjoyed watching her from behind the bushes. But at one point, his pleasure ended. The girl guessed that she was being watched. What happened next you will see in the game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2188630/Dear_Diary/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Dear Diary》是一部只供成人遊玩的視覺小說。故事的主角是個喜歡進林子採蘑菇的年輕人。在一個再尋常不過的日子裡，他遇見了一個姑娘。這次相遇徹底改變了他的人生！

翻開年輕人的私人日記，走進他的故事吧。他把發生在自己身上的事全都記了下來，包括他怎樣在樹林裡遇見那個姑娘，又怎樣開始偷窺她。姑娘正在湖裡裸身洗澡，他躲在灌木叢後看得津津有味。可這份樂趣沒能持續多久，姑娘察覺到有人在看她。再往後發生了什麼，就到遊戲裡看看吧。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2188630/Dear_Diary/]Steam[/url]］
